title: 第1143章 担心若依的慕容雪第1142章 震惊的两女
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
第1143章担心若依的慕容雪
只见岸边的慕容雪转身看向了公子。
朝着公子妩媚一笑。
“公子，好看吗？”
李蒙上下打量着慕容雪那丰腴的娇躯。
视线定格在了腰腹之下的阴影中。
李蒙脸上露出了玩味的笑容。
“嗯，很不错。”
慕容雪眼中闪过了一丝羞意。
强忍着逃入水中的冲动。
她朝着公子眨了眨眼睛。
“公子，大仇得报后若依的状态好了许多，只是若依被仇恨折磨了许多年，就算大仇得报恐怕一时间道心也难以归于平静，妾身有些担心若依那丫头。”
慕容雪是何意李蒙又怎会不知。
可怜天下父母心。
李蒙又怎会无动于衷。
这件事对李蒙而言本就是小事。
若依那丫头与自己也有些渊源。
虽然两人在未来会朝着什么方向发展还是未知之数。
但看在雪儿爱女心切的份上他就不会拒绝。
就在李蒙正欲答应时。

来自雪儿的神识传音响了起来。
“公子若是答应，在公子离开前，妾身与女儿定让公子有一个难忘的夜晚。”
李蒙神色平静的看着慕容雪。
两人四目相对。
李蒙毫不犹豫转身向传送阵走去。
看着公子离去的背影。
慕容雪脸上的笑容消失了。
眼中闪过了一丝惆怅。
昨夜她去找过若依。
若依似乎有意以身相许报恩。
就如同大嫂的女儿青衣那般陪伴公子。
虽说这有些不合适。
毕竟她与公子已经有了这层关系。
如果若依再成为公子的剑侍。
那她们母女岂不是事实上共……
那三个字慕容雪实在有些难以启齿。
但一想到大嫂与青衣那丫头。
好像也不是不能接受。
最重要的是若依有这个想法。
content_en:
Chapter 1143 Murong Xue is worried about Ruoyi
I saw Murong Xue on the bank turning to look at the young master.
She smiled charmingly at the young master.
"Sir, do you look good?"
Li Meng looked up and down at Murong Xue's plump body.
His gaze was fixed on the shadow below his waist and abdomen.
Li Meng had a playful smile on his face.
"Yeah, very good."
A trace of shame flashed in Murong Xue's eyes.
Resisting the urge to escape into the water.
She blinked at the young master.
"Sir, Ruoyi's condition has improved a lot after the great revenge was avenged. It's just that Ruoyi has been tortured by hatred for many years. Even if the great revenge is avenged, I'm afraid it will be difficult for Dao's heart to calm down for a while. I am a little worried about that girl Ruoyi."
How could Li Meng not know what Murong Xue meant?
I pity the hearts of parents in the world.
How could Li Meng remain indifferent?
This matter is a trivial matter to Li Meng.
The girl Ruoyi also has some connection with herself.
Although it is still unknown what direction the two will develop in the future.
But seeing how much Xueer loves his daughter, he won't refuse.
Just when Li Meng was about to agree.
The divine consciousness transmission from Xueer sounded.
"If the young master agrees, I and my daughter will give him an unforgettable night before he leaves."
Li Meng looked at Murong Xue calmly.
The two looked at each other.
Li Meng turned around and walked towards the teleportation array without hesitation.
Watching the young master's leaving figure.
The smile on Murong Xue's face disappeared.
A trace of melancholy flashed in his eyes.
She went to see Zoey last night.
Ruoyi seems to intend to repay the favor with her body.
Just like the sister-in-law's daughter Qingyi, she accompanies the young master.
Although this is somewhat inappropriate.
After all, she already has this relationship with the young master.
If Ruoyi becomes the young master's sword attendant again.
Then aren't they, mother and daughter, actually sharing...
Those three words were really hard for Murong Xue to say.
But when I think of my sister-in-law and that girl in Qingyi.
It doesn't seem unacceptable.
The most important thing is that Zoë has this idea.
